description: This file defines a mock class 'GstProtectionMetadataWrapperMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper' interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata in GstBuffer objects.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper interface for testing purposes.

methods.description: Mock method to simulate adding protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.description: Mock method to retrieve protection metadata data from a GstBuffer.

methods.description: Mock method to remove protection metadata from a GstBuffer.
